assessment: This important study advances our understanding of host-derived lipid droplets (LDs) interaction with intracellular pathogens. The use of amoeba species Dictyostelium discoideum as a host for Legionella pneumophila infection is compelling and goes beyond the current state of the art. The data were collected and analyzed using convincing methodology and this paper will interest cell biologists and microbiologists working on the interaction of microbes with host cells.
